description.value:
In brief 10-ft burst, 4d6 fire + 2d6 bludgeoning, DC 22 basic Reflex.

A single fired round, tracked as one item. On impact: 10-foot burst, 4d6 fire plus 2d6 bludgeoning damage, DC 22 basic Reflex save.

cinderfall.incomplete: The stated AoE burst (10-foot, 4d6 fire + 2d6 bludgeoning, DC 22 basic Reflex) has no rule-element or dedicated-field equivalent: this is a type:"ammo" item, and Foundry's ammo schema only modifies a fired weapon's own Strike (damage die/type, traits) -- it has no area or save-DC fields of its own, confirmed against real pf2e's own explosive-ammo pattern (Bomb Launcher, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/bomb-launcher.json, which instead re-fires an alchemical bomb item -- a full weapon/consumable with its own Strike -- through a launcher, rather than modeling the explosion as ammo). No launcher weapon exists anywhere in this corpus's weapon-ranged/ (checked all baseType values in use: heavy-rounds, pistol-rounds, rifle-rounds, shotgun-shells, sling-bullets -- no missiles/mortar-rounds launcher). Modeling this for real would need a new launcher weapon plus an attack/action item carrying its own damage+save, out of scope for a rule-element pass on the ammo card itself.
